evidence.observation: O2 at growth onset ~1.7 ppm, consistent with well-purged tube
O2 rises monotonically 1.7→6.5→12.2→18.7→20.7→25.3 ppm over growth, ~steady ingress rather than noise
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so rising O2 is not from reduced purge dilution
Thermocouple holds 750 °C with plausible heater power ~44%; thermal control normal
Pressure gauge not installed (null); leak cannot be cross-checked by pressure, but O2 channel alone already shows the trend

args.missing_evidence: A purge-rate step test (e.g. raising Ar to 200 sccm): a true leak's O2 should fall roughly in inverse proportion to flow, whereas sensor drift or outgassing would not track flow. Post-run O2 baseline at room temperature and a helium/pressure-decay leak check would confirm seal integrity.
